agent_priors_used: Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): long-horizon agents fail via compounding error and path dependence, so verification-before-store gates plus step-level fallback are the load-bearing product mechanism — used to keep Product/Runtime pointed at guards and coverage certificates rather than resolver tuning.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): memory beating no-memory is weak evidence; the load-bearing comparison is parameterized inheritance vs strong retrieval/compiled-procedural baselines at matched correctness on non-ceiling banks — used to protect the SBA-V3 multi-scale test against degenerate positive readings.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): cache/replay economics are dominated by recurrence rate h and fully-loaded write/verify/repair cost, not per-read compression ratios — used to route C-PRODUCT-ECON through first-party h(N)/Cwrite/Cmiss measurement and to bar stacking external compression with replay savings.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): observation representation (hidden affordances, selector exposure, accessibility tree) is a first-order confound in LLM-agent capability probes, separable from raw multi-step control — used to justify Intel's representation probe before any credential-gating conclusion on B3.

Agent prior (not SPIDER evidence): repeated MEASUREMENT_INVALID/REVISE with a shared cause is an upstream satisfiability/substrate defect to repair once or park, not a thread to extend — used to cap Physics estimator-battery work, hold the localhost N stop rule, and force Frontier/Graph repairs-or-park.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: LEGACY: DISTINCT_EXTENSION. This allocation is not a rerun: SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V3 certifies the non-ceiling dynamic range the old banks lacked, the shipped byte-identical parameterized carrier plus empty-registry ablation supply the treatment/comparator distinction, and counter-only cost per VERIFIED SAFE success with novelty-scaling is the new falsifier. allocation.question: Resume the pre-freeze experiment: on the certified non-ceiling credential-free bank (SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V3) with the shipped byte-identical parameterized carrier, does the founding multi-scale representation/work-compression hypothesis hold — i.e. does parameterized inheritance with decomposable/multi-resolution structure achieve strictly lower counter-cost (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) per VERIFIED SAFE success than strong internal baselines (flat exact-state cache, nearest-neighbour/retrieval, compiled procedural lookup, and the empty-registry inheritance ablation), with the advantage scaling with residual novelty rather than full task length?
allocation.rationale: Product holds an unfinished PREFREEZE experiment (EXP-PRODUCT-38315290076) whose active portfolio mandate is the bounded derisk before any flagship four-arm benchmark, and all three readiness gates route through it: it exercises the shipped executable carrier (B1), the certified non-ceiling bank (B2 already discharged via C-MEAS-VALID ROBUST), and the counter-only metric discipline the flagship needs. The inherited B11 probe-coverage handoff is superseded in sequence — not rejected — because the B11 boundary question is only interpretable once the multi-scale effect is or is not established, and no promotion crosses B11 without a measured coverage certificate regardless. If the SBA-V3 test shows no novelty-scaled advantage, the flagship stays unfunded.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Program is stable and legible: C-MEAS-VALID is the sole VALIDATED claim (bounded SBA-V3 fixture); C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY are EXPERIMENTAL at narrow ceilings; C-LLM-INHERIT, C-CROSSSITE, C-WEB-DYNAMICS, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-PRODUCT-ECON remain HYPOTHESIS. Five lanes carry frozen/prefrozen portfolio mandates that already encode the correct repairs, so five CONTINUEs preserve those transactions. Frontier, the sole idle lane, is reactivated with a single bounded repaired-design attempt (V3-gate-first, endpoint-only fallback) because its last result was operational invalidity, not falsification — a second invalid or null parks it. No expensive C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON flagship execution is authorized: B1 is exercised via the SBA-V3 derisk, B2 is discharged, B3 remains NOT_SATISFIED pending Intel's probe. The scarcest decisions remain refusals: no third localhost N increase, no substitute single-vantage ladder, no G3-variant after the frozen tau read, no promotion across B11 without a measured coverage certificate.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout brief (staff advice, not authority) was adopted where it matched Codex state and challenged nowhere it conflicted: its per-lane candidate directions independently converge with the frozen/prefrozen mandates (tau read, representation probe, vantage test, SBA-V3 derisk, denylist substrate, repaired-or-park Frontier) and its cross-lane dependency map (Runtime→Physics egress, B1/B2/B3 flagship gating, Graph→Product ship boundary) is accepted as the working dependency set. External findings (Agent JIT 10.4x decomposition, Anchor Action Index 93.3%/$0.016, PreAct verify-before-store, Asana 29–76x cache-hygiene savings) were treated strictly as priors requiring Intel reproduction with denominators — zero imported quantities enter any SPIDER cost model, upholding the hard bar on arXiv:2608.05784v1. Scout questions-for-director are answered: Frontier funded once then parked on null; B3 resolved via probe→credential/re-scope/gate fork; Graph parked to reuse/guard work on blind failure; B11 accepted as cap unless a measured coverage certificate is funded later; Physics estimator battery capped after the vantage test.
